title: Austin: Dogs, UT, Roads, City Finances
summary:
*   **Public Safety & Animals:** Finalized an ordinance regulating dog muzzling.
*   **Education & Development:** Approved a $50 appropriation to support the University of Texas's campaign for campus expansion and new buildings.
*   **Urban Planning:** Established precise dimensions for the central parking area and roadways on East Avenue, including specific parkway designs.
*   **City Finances:** Authorized payment of a 12.5% commission to private collectors for taxes gathered on credits.

Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew & Haynes 4

Dog Muzzling
Ordinance
✓ The Mayor laid before the Council An ordinance amending an ordinance entitled " An
ordinance regulating the muzzling of Dogs , and prescribing a penalty for the violation
thereof",
The ordinance was read the third time.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : That the width of the center parking area of East Avenue
from 2nd street south be and is hereby established as 80 feet between curb lines, Resolved
, that the width of roadway on each side of center parks be and is hereby established as
30 feet between curb lines,and Resolved, that the parkways be rectangular in shape and
that the corners of same be rounded to a fifteen foot radius ; and Park & East
Avenue
✓ Resolved, that the parkway between 1st & 2nd streets.[strikethrough]to the north curb
line of[/strikethrough] 1st street, from the south curb line of 2nd street to the north
curb line of 1st street, measured on the West side of East Avenue ; that the parkway
between 1st and Driskill streets extend from the south curb line of 1st street to the
north curb line of Driskill street; that the parkway south from Driskill street extend
from the south curb line of Driskill street a distance of approx-imately 165 feet ; the
center of this parkway to be on the center line of Willow street as extended from the
east,and that the south parkway be the same length as the north parkway and to start 30
feet from the parkway immediately north.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew & Haynes 4
Absent Councilman Powell - 1
Approved , A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

the City of Austin : Appropriation for
U. of T.

The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
